messages:
Priya: FYI onboarding report for orion-40k (int4) shows reproducible token drift on longprefill >48k. float32 baseline OK. suspect RoPE wrap / windowing interaction.
Mateo: can you share the short repro and which quant pack you used?
Priya: quant pipeline: int4-opt-2024-11, branch feature/quant-pipeline-2024. repro command: 
```
./bench/long_prefill_runner --model orion-40k --quant int4 --seed 7 --context 50000 --prefetch-window 12288 --force-kernel=vector
```
Priya: error pattern: after ~49120 tokens sequence, logits jump then sampling picks shifted token; kv fingerprint diff at index ~49112. logs: `rope: phase=wrap idx=49120 scale=1.0002` then `kv: idx-mismatch expected=0x9abf got=0x8f11`
Erin: interesting window size (12288) not a power-of-two. we've seen wrap artifacts when window boundaries don't align with rotary tile sizes. can you run with 16384 and 8192?
Tasha: also try `--rotary-rescale=legacy` vs `--rotary-rescale=adaptive` to see if scaling logic explains it.
Priya: ran quick diffs: 8192 -> diverge at ~32k, 12288 -> diverge at ~49k, 16384 -> diverge at ~65k. consistent with wrappoint shifting.
Mateo: could be prefetch index reuse across shard reassign. under int4 prefetch chunks are smaller so order changes. add verbose handshake logs: `export PREFETCH_LOG=debug` and dump `kv-indexes` after every window boundary.
ml-bot: queued longprefill delta jobs (id: lp-90021). will notify when runs finish.
Erin: another angle: quant kernel alter stride which can change timing; add `--force-kernel=scalar` to match float scheduling and `--force-kernel=vector` to reproduce. compare both.
Priya: note: seed fixed across runs. I've uploaded fingerprint dumps + logs to s3://redwood-eval/orion_longprefill/1829999999.tar.gz
Tasha: ops — can we get a 2-hour dedicated slot to run the full matrix at scale (4 nodes, pinned)? want to avoid noisy neighbor nondeterminism. cc @ops-bot
ops-bot: ack. reserving 4xA40 for team-ml on 2024-11-05T01:00Z-2024-11-05T03:00Z. ticket OP-7782 created.
Mateo: if this is RoPE wrap related we should instrument the kv encoder to include absolute token offsets and rope-phase per-key in dumps. will add small patch.
Priya: plan of action: 1) run matrix: prefetch-window {8192,12288,16384}, rotary-rescale {legacy,adaptive}, kernel {scalar,vector} 2) collect kv fingerprints + rope-phase traces 3) run float32 vs int4 fingerprint diff and bisect quant commits if divergence correlates 4) if root-cause is handshake/id reuse add guard that tags kv entries with monotonic request-uuid and validate on lookup
Erin: sounds good. if matrix reproduces reliably we can cut hotfix for handshake guard and include a canary rollout.
Priya: adding checklist on INF-1499. i'll start matrix tonight and post results here. :rocket:
ml-bot: longprefill jobs finished: float32 baseline OK. int4 vector kernel shows drift in 3/3 runs for window=12288. int4 scalar kernel matches float32 for all runs (lp-90021).
Mateo: scalar matching suggests a scheduling/timing reorder. next step bisect quant kernel changes between scalar and vector implementations.
Tasha: ping me when you want to run canary on dedicated; happy to shepherd.
Priya: thanks all 44d. attaching minimal log snippet for quick scan:
```
[00:12:01] token=49110 kv-fingerprint=0x9aef rope-phase=0x3b12
[00:12:02] prefetch push window=12288 id=0xabc1 req=0x1122
[00:12:02] handshake ack id=0xabc1 req=0x1122
[00:12:03] kernel vector chunk start seq=49111
[00:12:03] token-check expected=token_49111 actual=token_49110
```
Priya: uploaded artifacts, opening PR for instrumentation and will follow up with bisect results.
Erin: filing quick RFC for handshake-id guard pattern so we can standardize.
Mateo: I'll start bisect runs Monday morning.
Priya: INF-1499 will track. will update with triage summary after bisect.
